title: Guest Rating Below Superhost Threshold
dataSources: Airbnb bookings (`airbnb:booking`), Vrbo reservations (`vrbo:reservation`), Airbnb payouts (`airbnb:payout`), and guest reviews (`guest:review`).
app: Airbnb booking exports, Vrbo reservation webhooks, Airbnb payout statements, guest review logs, and turnover checklists streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=guest:review rating=* listing_name=*
| bin _time span=1q
| stats avg(rating) as avg_rating, count as reviews by _time listing_name
| where avg_rating<4.8 AND reviews>=3
| sort avg_rating
description: Flags listings whose quarterly average guest rating falls below the typical Superhost threshold.
value: Rating slippage is easier to fix mid-quarter than after Airbnb removes your Superhost badge.
implementation: Export guest reviews with numeric `rating` and review at least three reviews per listing each quarter.
visualization: Table of listings with quarterly average rating.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks rental listings whose guest ratings are slipping below Superhost levels.
